claims.name: domain-control
claims.definition: Subject is authorized for a DNS name, proven by a record at _atep.<domain> or https://<domain>/.well-known/atep.json.
claims.title: Domain control

claims.name: operator
claims.definition: Subject is operated by the named legal entity.
claims.title: Operator

claims.name: successor
claims.definition: Subject replaces the issuer's identity (key rotation).
claims.title: Successor

claims.name: issuer-authority
claims.definition: Subject may issue the listed claim types (chain delegation).
claims.title: Issuer authority

claims.name: audited
claims.definition: Subject passed the named audit on the given date; evidence hash required.
claims.title: Audited

claims.name: robotics/fleet-member
claims.definition: Subject belongs to the named fleet.
claims.title: Fleet member

claims.name: robotics/fleet-controller
claims.definition: Subject may issue motion and coordination commands for the fleet.
claims.title: Fleet controller

claims.name: robotics/safety-certified
claims.definition: Subject passed the named safety standard on the given date; evidence hash required.
claims.title: Safety certified

claims.name: robotics/sensor-source
claims.definition: Subject's named sensors are calibrated and trusted.
claims.title: Sensor source

claims.name: robotics/safety-authority
claims.definition: Subject may issue e-stops and geofence changes.
claims.title: Safety authority

claims.name: robotics/maintenance-authority
claims.definition: Subject may push firmware, configuration and key rotation.
claims.title: Maintenance authority

claims.name: robotics/peer-motion
claims.definition: Subject may send motion commands to the listed peers.
claims.title: Peer motion

claims.name: registry-endpoint
claims.definition: Subject operates the service at the given URL (registry, verifier, MCP server or A2A agent).
claims.title: Registry endpoint
